summary: First full pass: 16/16 fast backend pytest tests pass + long E2E pipeline test passes (script + Nano-Banana images + OpenAI TTS + ffmpeg MP4 in ~93s). All 6 frontend flows verified via Playwright with injected session cookies (landing, pricing, unauth redirects, dashboard, wizard, project view with real video, admin panel).

critical.issue: System dependency 'ffmpeg' (and DejaVu font used by drawtext) was NOT installed in the container, causing every generation to end with status=error 'No such file or directory: ffmpeg' during the 'composing video' stage. Fixed by installing 'ffmpeg' and 'fonts-dejavu' apt packages, but this must be added to the app's install/bootstrap script (Dockerfile/setup) so it survives container rebuilds.

minor.issue: expires_at/created_at are stored as ISO strings (via .isoformat()) while the seed script uses real Date objects. current_user() handles both, but persistence format is inconsistent — could bite future queries.

Credit is decremented up-front. On success path there is no refund logic if e.g. ffmpeg dependency missing at composing stage — refund only happens in the exception branch (which does work), but there is no locking so a user hitting Generate twice quickly could bypass the 'Already running' guard due to race between find_one and update_one.
Query-parameter body (credits=N via ?credits=) with POST is unusual REST; consider JSON body. Also there is no bound-check (credits can be set to negative).

issues: Badge text says 'Powered by GPT-5.2 · Nano Banana · OpenAI TTS' but backend actually uses model id 'gpt-5.4' (see server.py). Marketing/UI copy is inconsistent with implementation.

action_items: Add 'ffmpeg' and 'fonts-dejavu' (or bundle a font file) to the container/bootstrap install so video composition works after rebuilds. Right now the video pipeline is completely broken without these system packages.
Decide canonical model name and fix landing copy vs server.py (GPT-5.2 vs gpt-5.4).
Persist expires_at/created_at as datetime objects (not ISO strings) for consistency and index-friendliness.
Consider validating credits >= 0 in /api/admin/users/{uid}/credits and using JSON body instead of query param.
Optional: add atomic 'status == draft -> generating' update using find_one_and_update to prevent double-generate races.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes ISO-string and datetime for user_sessions.expires_at — coerced at read-time but should be normalized.

run_pipeline() does image generation sequentially (comment says so, to respect concurrent_request_limit). Fine, but 5 sequential Nano-Banana calls + TTS + ffmpeg still fit within ~90s for a 1-min video.
server.py returns fastapi HTTPException with detail as free-text; consider a structured error model.
Frontend api.js has no interceptor for 401 -> automatic logout/redirect; each protected page relies on /me at mount. Works but produces expected 401 console errors when unauthenticated.
Pricing.jsx CTA for non-enterprise plans does nothing (only 'sales' email opens). Confirmed acceptable per MVP note ('Upgrade plan CTA (no checkout)') — no action needed.

rca of the issue: Pipeline generation failed with 100% error rate. RCA: The FastAPI backend shells out to `ffmpeg` (and `ffprobe`) in `_ffmpeg_compose`/`_ffprobe_duration`, but the base container does NOT include ffmpeg. Reproduction: POST /api/projects then POST /api/projects/{id}/generate as an authenticated user; poll GET /api/projects/{id} — status transitions writing script -> generating images -> composing video -> failed with error 'No such file or directory: ffmpeg' (credit is auto-refunded, which does work). Mitigation applied in test container: `apt-get install -y ffmpeg fonts-dejavu`. Permanent fix: add these to the container's install manifest (Dockerfile/apt bootstrap).
